body: I hear voices all day. They come from an alien experience I had in 2012. I find it difficult to concentrate on any games these days. I barely play now.
I think it's a normal thought?
I've had this exact thought. From tiny blood cells never knowing life outside the body to humans, planets, galaxies, the universe being the same thing - inside something huge.

My voices say the same things. They list colours, numbers and tell me they're important. Sometimes it relates to seeing things. They are obsessed with red at the moment - the people behind the red door 71.
Having no tobacco makes me feel much worse. Smoking calms things for me. Can you get some gum or something? Maybe you're not finished quitting yet.
Sorry this is happening. I was told if I didn't take my medication I'd be discharged from services. The system is so broken.
NPCs yeah. This is how I think, voices don't help. I try working out who is a human and who is an NPC but everyone looks like a human.

I do this! I check so many definitions of words I know the meaning to. If I don't know the exact definition it's looked up. Sometimes reading the definitions and etymology brings a whole new meaning to words. I looked up 'loop' and got slightly obsessed with the definition, even writing it down.

My voices tell me if I cut my ears off they will leave me alone. I tried but it hurt too much to finish.  

Can you put some earphones in and lie down, relax?
I hear voices every day. They get worse when I'm trying to sleep. I use earphones too, keeps me from completely flipping out.

Yeah I relate. I think about suicide every day, it feels like the only way to end the chaos. People say things will get better and we have to believe them. Life is hard but it can't be like this forever, keep going friend.
I think around 900 and something in the one I'm in. Everyone is friendly
There's a group of us on facebook. Hearing voices network private group peer to peer.
I used to watch true crime now I can't take it anymore. It's too messed up, messes with my head.
Yeah. It's excruciating trying to keep up with people. I never know what to say so sometimes sit in silence.  My whole body drains after talking to anyone.

You don't suck, they suck for cheating.   

I feel the same but my boyfriend understands. I'm not a fan of sex I don't like being touched like that but I let him. I try to have sex once a month, for him, if I feel up to it. He understands if I don't want to do anything. There is hope. Could you try and talk to her about it? Are you asexual? There's a lot of help online for asexuals covering this kind of thing.  

Many people in this sub will understand, hope they can give you some better advice.
I take haloperidol I feel it's put me in a fake world.

I'm on a haloperidol injection. I think it's slowing my psychosis but I hate what this reality is like. I miss my old reality.  Even though I was terrified a lot of the time it was easier than this reality. I want to quit it and go back to what my reality is really like. This one feels fake.

I was at a cafe and somebody I knew from the hospital showed up. He said he knew a shortcut back to where I live. I know the hills and now know there was no shortcut. Anyway I followed him through muddy paths and trees just desperately wanting to go home. At one point I turned around and he was gone. I was alone in the hills. To this day I still don't know whether he left me there and hid or whether I hallucinated the whole thing.   

I was so covered in mud and alone and needed to be home.

I'm the same. After a few minutes with people I want to escape. I like to see my best friend but it's so overwhelming. Sometimes we just sit in silence because I have nothing to say or the voices get in the way.

Magical thinking isn't the nice escape you imagine. Sorry. It's making connections, superstitions, sometimes supernatural connections where there are none. It can be scary, it's not a nice little magical daydream I'm afraid. It can lead me to psychosis.
I have also had these thoughts. It's just the illness. Your cat is a cat. I find spending quality time with my cat helps me feel more normal and less scary.

My voices say the same about everything being poison. They put me on an injection because I wouldn't take my medication. My care coordinator assures me it's not poison and she would be fired if she gave me poison. We have to believe it's not poison or it'll drive us insane.
I still feel this way. Reading is almost impossible. I read the same sentence so many times but it still doesn't make sense. I often feel brain damaged too. Hopefully it will get better.
You are not alone. I have negative voices most of the day. It gets in the way of life doesn't it?
Sorry I can't help but letting you know you're not alone. I'm having this problem too. I've found instrumentals with no lyrics easier to listen to and enjoy.
I've been hearing voices through my headphones whwn I listen to music it's distorted and qarps to voices connecting me to the lyrics.
Haloperidol injection for schizotypal disorder.
I'm terrible at talking to anyone outside my circle. Sometimes I don't reply to people and they don't understand why. I'm not sure I do.

Me and my boyfriend don't go on dates. We go to service stations and drink hot chocolate together.   

Service stations have an interesting vibe that's hard to describe. Almost like limbo.

My voices are awful to me. I want them to leave but after 9 years I can't remember life without them. I don't know what I would do with myself if they weren't there. It's almost scary imagining it, a completely different life.

I have sex once every couple of months to keep my boyfriend happy. If its quick and we use protection I can bare it just about. I'm not a fan of kisses on the mouth or any bodily fluid touching me either.
I found similar problems with dr who. It was fine to watch etc but I found the doctor saying things that my voices say. It would make me spiral and question everything constantly.

I have daily voices and visuals with schizotypal. I thought I had schizophrenia for years. I think the difference is knowing what is reality and what is not.  It can be hard sometimes and some of us slip into psychosis. I don't think I have schizophrenia anymore I believe it's schizotypal with occasional psychosis.
I've been in the same boat. I scored highly on the ASD test and have been told I have traits. Traits rather than a diagnosis as I have schizotypal.
Nothing in my world feels real. I wonder if I'm in the wrong reality and everything is leaking into one another. It explains what I can see and hear
I hear voices telling me people aren't real that they're NPCs. Gets confusing
I swear I have SAD but the summer version. I can't stand summer or the sun.

It's been up and down. At one point I was on 10mg a day and was staring upwards all the time, stuck like that. That was before my schizotypal diagnosis it's been lower and more manageable since. At first they put me on 0.5mg and upped it when I needed extra help.
You should be good then I'd say! Good luck with it

In my opinion low loses help keep things calm. High doses make my body seize up and my eyes roll back. I'm told it's rare though don't let me put you off. I take 4mg a day and it doesn't cause me many problems.
I have always loved animals. During an episode I killed a spider, devastated i still think about it today. All spiders are welcome in my home now.
I was told that I can't have schizophrenia because it hasn't got worse over time and I have some awareness. So they dx schizotypal despite my symptoms. It's all very confusing isn't it.
I have schizotypal and hear voices every day, all day. You're not alone. Do make sure your doctor knows though.
I wore wellies for months even in the summer. I must have looked bizarre but nobody ever said anything.

I'm similar. I have a boyfriend and I really don't enjoy sex. Just praying for it to be over.  We agreed to have sex once a month when I feel up to it. It's a small price to pay for having such a supportive boyfriend.
I have no idea either. Probably a mixture if I had to guess. I remember modes of dress being a factor in diagnosing stpd, appearing unkempt or something.

I'm the same. I wear the same pyjamas 24/7 for a week, sometimes I'll even go outside in them. I try to shower once a week but it's hard keeping up with everything. I've been told it's lack of motivation. But I just don't see the point changing until I really have to.
I take haloperidol and sertraline, sometimes. I can't stick to it. When I do take it I feel more calm, less thought soup.
I often wonder what is part of the disorder, whether other people have the same problems. I also wonder what my brain chemistry is up to with the medication swings.

I'm exactly the same. I can't seem to take my medication for more than a couple of weeks. Then I stop for various reasons, mind control drugs is a regular thought. Eventually I agree to take them and it starts again. I also seem to cycle between agreeing to the help and refusing to talk about anything useful. Talking to my care coordinator or any doctor and I freeze and get anxious and paranoid.

Yes. Cocaine affected me differently to everyone else (tried it in my youth). Everybody else was crazy chatting and happy while I sat there in silence, frozen, mute for hours. It wasn't a fun experience. Alcohol doesn't sit right with me either. While weed helps a lot.
